name: connectcases
description: Cases actions Cases data types With Amazon Connect Cases, your agents can track and manage customer issues that require multiple interactions, follow-up tasks, and teams in your contact center.

subcommands.name: batch-get-case-rule
subcommands.description: Gets a batch of case rules.

subcommands.name: batch-get-field
subcommands.description: Returns the description for the list of fields in the request parameters.

subcommands.name: batch-put-field-options
subcommands.description: Creates and updates a set of field options for a single select field in a Cases domain.

subcommands.name: create-case
subcommands.description: If you provide a value for PerformedBy.UserArn you must also have connect:DescribeUser permission on the User ARN resource that you provide Creates a case in the specified Cases domain.

subcommands.name: create-case-rule
subcommands.description: Creates a new case rule.

subcommands.name: create-domain
subcommands.description: Creates a domain, which is a container for all case data, such as cases, fields, templates and layouts.

subcommands.name: create-field
subcommands.description: Creates a field in the Cases domain.

subcommands.name: create-layout
subcommands.description: Creates a layout in the Cases domain.

subcommands.name: create-related-item
subcommands.description: Creates a related item (comments, tasks, and contacts) and associates it with a case.

subcommands.name: create-template
subcommands.description: Creates a template in the Cases domain.

subcommands.name: delete-case
subcommands.description: The DeleteCase API permanently deletes a case and all its associated resources from the cases data store.

subcommands.name: delete-case-rule
subcommands.description: Deletes a case rule.

subcommands.name: delete-domain
subcommands.description: Deletes a Cases domain.

subcommands.name: delete-field
subcommands.description: Deletes a field from a cases template.

subcommands.name: delete-layout
subcommands.description: Deletes a layout from a cases template.

subcommands.name: delete-related-item
subcommands.description: Deletes the related item resource under a case.

subcommands.name: delete-template
subcommands.description: Deletes a cases template.

subcommands.name: get-case
subcommands.description: Returns information about a specific case if it exists.

subcommands.name: get-case-audit-events
subcommands.description: Returns the audit history about a specific case if it exists.

subcommands.name: get-case-event-configuration
subcommands.description: Returns the case event publishing configuration.

subcommands.name: get-domain
subcommands.description: Returns information about a specific domain if it exists.

subcommands.name: get-layout
subcommands.description: Returns the details for the requested layout.

subcommands.name: get-template
subcommands.description: Returns the details for the requested template.

subcommands.name: list-case-rules
subcommands.description: Lists all case rules in a Cases domain.

subcommands.name: list-cases-for-contact
subcommands.description: Lists cases for a given contact.

subcommands.name: list-domains
subcommands.description: Lists all cases domains in the Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: list-field-options
subcommands.description: Lists all of the field options for a field identifier in the domain.

subcommands.name: list-fields
subcommands.description: Lists all fields in a Cases domain.

subcommands.name: list-layouts
subcommands.description: Lists all layouts in the given cases domain.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Lists tags for a resource.

subcommands.name: list-templates
subcommands.description: Lists all of the templates in a Cases domain.

subcommands.name: put-case-event-configuration
subcommands.description: Adds case event publishing configuration.

subcommands.name: search-all-related-items
subcommands.description: Searches for related items across all cases within a domain.

subcommands.name: search-cases
subcommands.description: Searches for cases within their associated Cases domain.

subcommands.name: search-related-items
subcommands.description: Searches for related items that are associated with a case.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Adds tags to a resource.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Untags a resource.

subcommands.name: update-case
subcommands.description: If you provide a value for PerformedBy.UserArn you must also have connect:DescribeUser permission on the User ARN resource that you provide Updates the values of fields on a case.

subcommands.name: update-case-rule
subcommands.description: Updates a case rule.

subcommands.name: update-field
subcommands.description: Updates the properties of an existing field.

subcommands.name: update-layout
subcommands.description: Updates the attributes of an existing layout.

subcommands.name: update-related-item
subcommands.description: Updates the content of a related item associated with a case.

subcommands.name: update-template
subcommands.description: Updates the attributes of an existing template.
